name: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Selection Test (JNVST - Class 6)
description: National residential school entrance system offering 100% free quality co-educational residential education from Class 6 to 12 for talented rural students.
income_criteria: No income ceiling. 100% free boarding, lodging, education, and uniforms for all students up to Class 8, and for girls, SC/ST, and BPL students from Class 9 to 12.
category_requirements: At least 75% of seats in a district are reserved for rural candidates. Specific reservations for SC, ST, OBC, and Divyang as per Govt of India rules.
academic_requirements: Candidate must be bonafide student studying in Class 5 in a recognized school in the same district during the academic session.
admission_or_exam_requirements: Selection is purely merit-based through the nationwide JNVST competitive entrance test (Mental Ability, Arithmetic, and Language).
benefits: Completely free schooling, modern hostels, nutritious meals, textbooks, school uniforms, and digital classroom education up to Class 12.
documents_required: Certificate verified by the Head Master of the current school confirming Class 5 study
Aadhaar Card or Residence Certificate of parent/candidate
Birth Certificate (candidate must meet prescribed age bracket, typically 10 to 12 years)
Rural Study Certificate if claiming rural quota
Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC) if applicable
application_steps: Step 1: Check admission notification on official NVS portal (navodaya.gov.in).
Step 2: Obtain study certificate format and get it certified by the Headmaster of the Class 5 school.
Step 3: Register online on the NVS admission portal with photograph, candidate signature, parent signature, and certificate.
Step 4: Download JNVST admit card when released by NVS.
Step 5: Appear for the JNVST entrance examination at the designated district centre.
Step 6: Check district-wise merit list and complete document verification at the local Navodaya Vidyalaya.
application_deadline: Current deadline needs verification (Annual cycle; verify on official portal)

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme to arrest drop-out of meritorious students studying in government/aided schools at Class 8 and support secondary schooling.
income_criteria: Total annual parental income from all sources must not exceed ₹3,50,000.
category_requirements: Open to all categories meeting income and school criteria; reservations apply as per state policy.
academic_requirements: Minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST) in Class 7 annual examination; must be enrolled in Govt, Local Body, or Govt-aided school in Class 8.
admission_or_exam_requirements: Selection through State Level NMMS Examination comprising Mental Ability Test (MAT) and Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT).
benefits: Scholarship amount of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) paid through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) from Class 9 to Class 12.
documents_required: Class 7 marks card / passing certificate
Parental Income Certificate issued by competent revenue authority (Tahsildar)
Aadhaar Card linked to student bank account
Bank Account Passbook (single/joint with parent)
School bonafide certificate confirming enrollment in Class 8 in Govt/Aided school
application_steps: Step 1: School or candidate submits application for State NMMS Exam through state education department portal (e.g., KSEAB in Karnataka).
Step 2: Appear for the state-level MAT and SAT competitive written tests.
Step 3: After qualifying in merit list, register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Step 4: School verifies application online on NSP.
Step 5: District and State Nodal Officers approve eligibility.
Step 6: Annual ₹12,000 scholarship is disbursed via DBT Public Financial Management System (PFMS).
application_start_date: State exam usually Aug-Oct; NSP registration Oct-Dec
application_deadline: Current deadline needs verification (Annual cycle; check NSP portal)

name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College & University Students (CSSS)
description: Financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing graduate and professional studies.
income_criteria: Gross annual parental/family income must not exceed ₹4,50,000.
category_requirements: General, OBC, SC, ST, EWS (divided across state boards based on population quota).
academic_requirements: Candidate must score above 80th percentile of successful candidates in relevant stream in Class 12 board examination and pursue regular (not distance) courses.
admission_or_exam_requirements: Admission to recognized degree college or university recognized by UGC, AICTE, MCI/NMC, or DGT.
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum for the first 3 years of Undergraduate study; ₹20,000 per annum for 4th/5th year (BTech/Professional) and Postgraduate level.
documents_required: Class 12 Marks Card showing board roll number and percentile rank
Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority
Aadhaar Card
College Admission Fee Receipt and Bonafide Student Certificate
Active bank account linked to Aadhaar (DBT enabled)
application_steps: Step 1: Check your board's 80th percentile cutoff list on your State Board / CBSE / CISCE website.
Step 2: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) under Higher Education schemes.
Step 3: Complete Aadhaar One-Time Registration (OTR) and fill applicant details.
Step 4: Upload Class 12 marksheet, income proof, and bonafide college certificate.
Step 5: Institute Nodal Officer (INO) verifies student enrollment on NSP.
Step 6: Ministry of Education sanctions scholarship and disburses via DBT.
application_deadline: Current deadline needs verification (Annual cycle; check NSP portal)

name: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Post-Matric Scholarship
description: Unified Karnataka state portal offering tuition fee reimbursement, maintenance allowances, and fee waivers to eligible pre-university, degree, engineering, and polytechnic students.
income_criteria: SC/ST: Annual family income up to ₹2,50,000. Cat-1: Up to ₹2,50,000. 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B (OBC) & EWS: Annual income up to ₹1,00,000.
category_requirements: Karnataka domicile students belonging to SC, ST, OBC (Backward Classes), Minorities, or Economically Weaker Sections.
academic_requirements: Passed qualifying examination (SSLC for PUC; PUC for Degree/Engineering); regular enrollment in recognized Karnataka institution.
admission_or_exam_requirements: Valid admission in university/college with Kutumba ID and Student Achievement Tracking System (SATS) / College registration number.
benefits: Full or partial tuition fee concession/reimbursement paid directly to institution; monthly maintenance allowance credited to student bank account.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of student and parent
Karnataka Kutumba Family ID (kutumba.karnataka.gov.in)
Caste and Income Certificate with 15-digit RD Number (Revenue Dept)
SSLC / 10th Marks Card and PUC / previous year marks card
College Admission Fee Receipt and Bonafide Certificate
Hostel registration details (if staying in college/govt hostel)
application_steps: Step 1: Obtain a Kutumba ID by linking family Aadhaar details on the Karnataka Kutumba portal.
Step 2: Visit ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in and create an SSP student account.
Step 3: Enter your Caste & Income Certificate RD numbers for instant automatic digital verification.
Step 4: Enter college admission university registration number / USN / student ID.
Step 5: Submit application online; college e-attestation officer verifies course credentials.
Step 6: Department (Social Welfare, BCWD, or Tribal Welfare) sanctions fee concession and scholarship.
application_deadline: Current deadline needs verification (Annual cycle; check SSP Karnataka)

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
description: Scheme to provide encouragement and support to meritorious young women to pursue technical diploma and degree education in AICTE approved institutions.
income_criteria: Total family annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹8,00,000.
category_requirements: Strictly limited to female students. Maximum two girl children per family eligible.
academic_requirements: Candidate must be admitted to 1st year of technical Degree/Diploma course (or 2nd year through lateral entry) in an AICTE approved college via centralized counseling.
admission_or_exam_requirements: Admission through State Entrance Test (e.g., KCET/COMEDK in Karnataka) or Central Counseling (JEE Main / JoSAA).
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study towards college tuition fees, purchase of laptop/books, and educational equipment.
documents_required: Class 10 and Class 12 marksheets
AICTE College Admission Letter and Central Counseling Allotment Letter
Annual Family Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar / Competent Authority (under ₹8 Lakhs)
Aadhaar Card
Parent declaration confirming not more than two daughters are availing scholarship
Tuition Fee Receipt paid for the current academic session
application_steps: Step 1: Secure admission into 1st year Degree/Diploma at an AICTE approved college.
Step 2: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) under AICTE schemes.
Step 3: Fill academic credentials, entrance rank, and upload income and bonafide certificates.
Step 4: College Nodal Officer verifies student credentials and AICTE approval code.
Step 5: Merit list is compiled based on Class 12 / qualifying diploma exam performance.
Step 6: ₹50,000 annual grant is credited to the student's bank account.
application_deadline: Current deadline needs verification (Annual cycle; check NSP portal)

name: NEET-UG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test)
description: Unified national competitive entrance examination conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for admission to undergraduate medical (MBBS), dental (BDS), and AYUSH courses nationwide.
income_criteria: No income restriction for taking the examination. Subsidized application fee slabs exist for SC/ST/PwD/OBC/EWS candidates.
category_requirements: Open to all Indian Citizens, NRIs, OCIs, and Foreign Nationals meeting age and subject criteria.
academic_requirements: Candidate must have passed or be appearing in Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English as core subjects with minimum prescribed marks (50% General, 40% SC/ST/OBC).
admission_or_exam_requirements: Must have completed 17 years of age on or before 31st December of the admission year. No upper age limit.
benefits: Single gateway qualification score for 100% of MBBS and BDS seats in India (All India 15% Quota, 85% State Quotas including KEA Karnataka, AIIMS, and JIPMER).
documents_required: Recent passport-size photograph (with white background and date)
Postcard-size photograph and candidate signature
Left and right-hand fingers and thumb impressions
Class 10 pass certificate (for date of birth proof)
Class 12 marksheet (or self-declaration if appearing)
Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/GEN-EWS/PwBD) if applicable
Aadhaar Number / Passport / Voter ID for identity verification
application_steps: Step 1: Check official information bulletin on exams.nta.ac.in/NEET or neet.nta.nic.in.
Step 2: Register on NTA portal using Aadhaar authentication or Digilocker.
Step 3: Fill personal details, choice of examination cities, and academic qualification details.
Step 4: Upload scanned photographs, signature, and category certificates.
Step 5: Pay the online examination application fee (General: approx ₹1,700; EWS/OBC: ₹1,600; SC/ST/PwBD: ₹1,000).
Step 6: Download and save the Confirmation Page for future counseling with KEA / MCC.
application_deadline: Current deadline needs verification (Annual cycle; check official NTA portal)

name: JEE (Main) - Joint Entrance Examination
description: National entrance examination conducted by NTA for admission to BTech/BE and BArch programmes at NITs, IIITs, CFTIs, and qualifying examination for JEE (Advanced) for IITs.
income_criteria: No income ceiling to take examination. Reduced application fee for reserved categories.
category_requirements: Open to all Indian Nationals, NRIs, and foreign candidates.
academic_requirements: Candidate must have passed Class 12 or equivalent with Physics and Mathematics as mandatory subjects along with Chemistry/Biology/Technical Vocational subjects.
admission_or_exam_requirements: No age limit for appearing in JEE (Main). Allowed to appear for 3 consecutive years starting from the year of passing Class 12.
benefits: Enables merit-based admission into premier engineering colleges (NITs, IIITs, top state colleges via CSAB/JoSAA) and entry eligibility to JEE Advanced.
documents_required: Scanned passport photograph and signature
Class 10 and 12 certificates / roll number
Category Certificate (GEN-EWS / OBC-NCL / SC / ST / PwD) if applicable
Aadhaar Number / ABC ID / Digilocker verification
application_steps: Step 1: Visit official website (jeemain.nta.nic.in).
Step 2: Register online using Aadhaar or Digilocker login.
Step 3: Select examination session (Session 1 or Session 2) and paper (Paper 1 BTech or Paper 2 BArch).
Step 4: Upload required documents and choose exam cities.
Step 5: Pay exam fee online and download confirmation receipt.
application_start_date: Session 1 typically opens Nov-Dec; Session 2 opens Feb-March
application_deadline: Current deadline needs verification (Check official NTA portal)

name: Right to Education (RTE Section 12(1)(c)) Free School Admission
description: Statutory provision reserving 25% of entry-level seats (LKG or Class 1) in private unaided non-minority schools for children from disadvantaged and economically weaker sections with 100% free tuition.
income_criteria: Economically Weaker Section (EWS): Total annual family income must not exceed ₹3,50,000.
category_requirements: Children from Disadvantaged Groups (SC, ST, Category-1, Orphan, HIV-affected, Transgender child, Child with Special Needs) and Weaker Sections.
academic_requirements: Entry-level age criteria (3 years 10 months to 4 years 10 months for LKG; 5 years 10 months to 6 years 10 months for Class 1).
admission_or_exam_requirements: Neighborhood residence criteria: School must fall within the defined geographical neighborhood boundary / ward where no government school is available, as per amended Karnataka RTE rules.
benefits: 100% free education from LKG/Class 1 up to completion of elementary education (Class 8). Tuition fees are reimbursed by Govt of Karnataka.
documents_required: Child's Birth Certificate (issued by Gram Panchayat / BBMP / Municipality)
Child and Parent Aadhaar Cards
Income & Caste Certificate with 15-digit RD Number (Revenue Dept)
Proof of Residence (Ration Card, Voter ID, Aadhaar, Electricity Bill)
Special category certificate (if claiming Orphan/Disability quota)
application_steps: Step 1: Check notification on schooleducation.karnataka.gov.in.
Step 2: Register on the Karnataka RTE online admission portal using child's Aadhaar.
Step 3: Select neighborhood schools based on residential pincode and ward.
Step 4: Government conducts automated computerized lottery for oversubscribed seats.
Step 5: Selected candidates report to the allotted private school with original certificates for admission confirmation.
application_deadline: Current deadline needs verification (Annual cycle; check Karnataka Education Dept)

name: Karnataka Vidyasiri (Food & Accommodation Scheme / E-Pass)
description: Financial monthly stipend provided by the Karnataka Backward Classes Welfare Department to post-matric students who could not secure admission in department hostels.
income_criteria: Cat-1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B: Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 (Cat-1) or ₹1,00,000 (other OBC groups).
category_requirements: Students belonging to Category-1, 2A, 2B, 3A, and 3B residing in rural areas outside the city/town where their college is situated.
academic_requirements: Minimum 75% monthly attendance in the college; minimum passing marks in previous examination.
admission_or_exam_requirements: Student must not have been allotted a government hostel and distance from home town to college must be at least 5 km.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 per month for 10 months (Total ₹15,000 per academic year) directly credited to student's bank account for boarding and lodging.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of student
Caste and Income Certificate (RD number from Nada Kacheri)
Bank Passbook seeded with Aadhaar
SSLC / Previous Exam Marks Card
College Bonafide Certificate showing attendance details
Certificate of non-allotment of Government Hostel
application_steps: Step 1: Check application window on bcwd.karnataka.gov.in or through SSP Karnataka portal.
Step 2: Submit online application through Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP).
Step 3: College principal verifies attendance and hostel non-admission status.
Step 4: Taluk Backward Classes Welfare Officer scrutinizes and approves application.
Step 5: Monthly payment of ₹1,500 is disbursed directly via Aadhaar-linked DBT.
application_deadline: Current deadline needs verification (Annual cycle; check BCWD portal)

name: PM SHRI Schools Initiative (PM Schools for Rising India)
description: Centrally sponsored scheme upgrading designated Central (KVs, JNVs) and State government schools into exemplary institutions with modern laboratories, smart classrooms, sports facilities, and NEP 2020 experiential learning.
income_criteria: Open to all students under standard government / Kendriya Vidyalaya / Navodaya fee structures (free or nominal fees as per school norms; free for RTE and disadvantaged categories).
category_requirements: Open admissions as per normal Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS), Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), or State Department rules.
academic_requirements: Admission requirements vary by grade and school authority (Class 1 lottery, Class 6 JNVST for Navodaya, general transfer/admission norms for KVs).
admission_or_exam_requirements: Admission managed by designated PM SHRI school institutions directly through respective portals (e.g., KVS online admission portal or NVS portal).
benefits: Access to high-standard smart classrooms, digital library, STEM labs, vocational exposure, sports equipment, and zero/minimal tuition fees in public institutions.
documents_required: Birth Certificate of child
Aadhaar Card of child and parent
Previous class transfer certificate and marks card (for Class 2 and above)
Residence proof
Category certificate if claiming reservation
application_steps: Step 1: Explore the PM SHRI school locator on pmshrischools.education.gov.in to find designated schools in your district.
Step 2: Visit the parent school system portal (e.g., kvsangathan.nic.in for KVs, navodaya.gov.in for JNVs, or Karnataka School Education portal for state schools).
Step 3: Follow the respective annual admission timeline (typically February-March for KVs).
Step 4: Register child online and submit required certificates at the designated school.
application_start_date: Varies by school authority (KVS: Feb-March; NVS: July-August)
application_deadline: Current deadline needs verification (Check respective school authority portal)
